name: Underfed
description: Moves a channel to its next source when the provider keeps delivering the stream, but at a fraction of the bitrate the content needs.
author: PilaScat

fields.label: API key *
fields.help_text: A Dispatcharr API key. Settings → Users → the account whose key you want to use. The watcher needs it to read channel status and to change source.

fields.label: Observe only
fields.help_text: Records what it would have done without doing it. Leave it on for the first evening, then read the journal under Check status.

fields.label: Trigger below (% of content rate)
fields.help_text: reservoarr reports how many bytes have arrived (in_total) and how many bits the picture needs (crate). Below this share over the last 45 seconds, with the cushion empty, the source counts as underfed.

fields.label: Confirm for (seconds)
fields.help_text: How long the shortfall must last before acting. Short dips recover on their own.

fields.label: Switches per hour, per channel
fields.help_text: Stops a channel bouncing between two sources that are both weak.

fields.label: Ignore first (seconds)
fields.help_text: Right after a channel opens the measured content rate is not trustworthy yet.

fields.label: Stable after (seconds)
fields.help_text: A source that holds up this long is treated as recovered.

fields.label: Excluded channels
fields.help_text: One channel name per line. Those keep whatever source they are on.

fields.label: reservoarr log
fields.help_text: Where reservoarr writes delaybuf.log inside this container. Change it only if RESV_LOG_DIR was moved.

fields.label: Dispatcharr URL
fields.help_text: Reached from inside the container. Change it only on a non-standard port.

actions.label: Apply settings
actions.description: Applies the settings above and starts the watcher.

actions.label: Check status
actions.description: Reports whether the watcher is running and what it changed recently.

actions.label: Replay the log
actions.description: Runs the current thresholds over the whole log without changing anything.

actions.label: Restart watcher
actions.description: Starts the watcher again if it is down.

actions.label: Stop watcher
actions.description: Stops the watcher and leaves every channel on its current source.

confirm.title: Stop the watcher?
confirm.message: Underfed sources will no longer be moved to the next source in the chain.
